fullPassage:
Bull Market vs. Bear Market

Stock market movement can be divided into two major trends: bull market vs. bear market.

BULL MARKET
A bull market is a rising stock market situation in which economic conditions are favorable to investors. They include high employment rates, GDP increases, and other positive economic indicators. Think of a charging bull in a field raising its horns. In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future performance. As such, they increase their stock purchases and maintain their investments.

BEAR MARKET
Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market implies a decline in stock values. It occurs when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience decreases in value. Factors like low GDP growth, rising unemployment, and low wages are possible conditions for a bear market. In difficult economic situations, investors frequently have negative views of the stock market, which may lead them to sell their stocks.

questions.passage: Stock market movement can be ①<u>divided</u> into two major trends: bull market vs. bear market. A bull market is a rising stock market situation in ②<u>which</u> economic conditions are favorable to investors. They include high employment rates, GDP increases, and other positive economic ③<u>indicators</u>. Think of a charging bull in a field ④<u>raised</u> its horns.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①구분된다 ②관계대명사 ③지표들 ④들어 올리는(raising)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ raised → raising: 현재분사로 동시 동작 표현. 'a bull raising its horns' (뿔을 들어올리고 있는 황소)
❌ ①②③: 모두 적절
det.tip: 현재분사(~ing)로 동시 동작: a bull raising its horns = 뿔을 들어올리는 황소

questions.passage: Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market implies a decline in stock values. It ①<u>occurs</u> when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience ②<u>decrease</u> in value. Factors like low GDP growth, rising unemployment, and low wages are ③<u>possible</u> conditions for a bear market. In difficult economic situations, investors frequently have negative views of the stock market, ④<u>which</u> may lead them to sell their stocks.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①발생하다 ②감소(decreases) ③가능한 ④관계대명사
det.analysis:
✅ ② decrease → decreases: 'experience decreases in value' — decreases는 복수 명사(감소들)로 사용. 동사라면 3인칭 단수 -s 필요하지만 여기서는 명사 복수형이 원문
❌ ①③④: 모두 적절
det.tip: decrease(명사/동사) — 여기서는 복수 명사 decreases(여러 차례의 감소)

questions.passage: A bull market is a rising stock market situation in which economic conditions are favorable to investors. In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future performance. As ①<u>such like</u>, they increase their stock purchases and maintain their investments. Like a standing bear ②<u>having</u> lowered its front legs, a bear market implies a ③<u>decline</u> in stock values. It occurs when economic conditions are ④<u>not</u> favorable.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①그러므로(As such) ②가진 채 ③하락 ④~않은
det.analysis:
✅ ① such like → such: 'As such' = '그러므로'가 정확한 표현. 'As such like'은 비문법적
❌ ②③④: 모두 적절
det.tip: As such = 그러므로, 따라서 / such like은 비표준 표현

questions.passage: A bull market is a rising stock market situation in which economic conditions are ①<u>favorable</u> to investors. They include high employment rates, GDP increases, and other ②<u>positive</u> economic indicators. In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future performance. As such, they ③<u>decrease</u> their stock purchases and ④<u>maintain</u> their investments.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①유리한 ②긍정적 ③(줄이다→)늘리다(increase) ④유지하다
det.analysis:
✅ ③ decrease(줄이다) → increase(늘리다): 강세장에서 투자자는 매입을 '늘린다'
❌ ①②④: 모두 원문 그대로 적절
det.tip: increase(늘리다) ↔ decrease(줄이다) / 강세장 → 매입 증가

questions.passage: Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market implies a ①<u>decline</u> in stock values. It occurs when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience decreases in value. In difficult economic situations, investors frequently have ②<u>positive</u> views of the stock market, which may ③<u>lead</u> them to ④<u>sell</u> their stocks.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①하락 ②(긍정적→)부정적(negative) ③이끌다 ④매도하다
det.analysis:
✅ ② positive(긍정적) → negative(부정적): 어려운 경제 상황에서 투자자는 '부정적' 견해를 가짐
❌ ①③④: 모두 원문 그대로 적절
det.tip: negative(부정적) ↔ positive(긍정적) / 약세장 → 부정적 견해 → 매도
